main_text.p: uel parem par(ut Petrum Paulus,Gal.2.) obiurget, uel superior ætate,fide,officio, inferiorem aliquem? Notum est exemplum Danielis, qui Senes accusauit: si modò historicum est.

Reprehensi quotuplices.5. Iam si eos qui reprehenduntur spectes, uel bene sibi conscij sunt, uel male. Si bene, ἀνωαδιλησίαν[?] illam ob specialem innocentiam, non parum diluit communis reatus conscientia, quæ pungitur reprehensionis aculeo. Si male sibi conscij sunt, tum in eis animus sibi cōscius, uoce reprehensoris ad Dei omnium ἐπόψει[?] tribunal se pertrahi sentiens, αὐτοκατάκριτος est.

6. Porrò, cum sit mira ingeniorum uarietas, alij malum dissimulant, alij illud ingenuè fatentur. Quomodo utriqj tractandi sint, hæc Patrum dicta monent? Bern. sup. Cantica.Mansueti benignè corripiendi sunt, inquieti seuerè. Item: Iuuenes, inquit Ambrosius, plerumq; seueritas admonitionis ad profectum dirigit: senes uerò ad meliora opera deprecatio blanda componit.
De reprehen-sione.7. Iusta tamen sit & tempestiua reprehensio oportet. Iusta erit, si uituperanda & laudanda non sumantur promiscuè; sed illa reprehendantur aperte, hæc col-lau-

page.notes: Printed "Mansueti benignè corripiedi sunt" reads "corripiedi" in the scan; left as printed, marked as spelling variant of corripiendi is not applied. Greek words in para 5 are uncertain in their exact letters and are marked [?]. The final line is cut at the bottom edge; "lau-" is the printed hyphenated start of the next word. The note "De reprehen-sione" is split across two lines in print. The running head is copied as printed with long s replaced by s.
